symbols.name: edge rank
symbols.meaning: The rank of an edge matrix, which counts the smaller calls that edge costs.
symbols.quote: Here $a$ is the rank of an edge matrix, not the bank value of the earlier page: an edge matrix of rank $a$ costs $a$ smaller calls.

symbols.name: smaller call count
symbols.meaning: The total number of smaller calls over all roles, which is the count the recursion's cost is measured by.
symbols.quote: Let $s$ be the total number of smaller calls over all $W$ roles.

relations.quote: Rank-saving recursion is a recursive scheme that runs on a [linear network](linear-network.md), paying for each edge with a few smaller calls and keeping the total number of calls small.
The recursion splits its array into [role streams from a cyclic row split](role-streams.md) across the $W$ roles, so each role carries an equal share of the volume, the number of bits stored.
It is stated in the [frame of a vertex](frame.md) at each end of an edge, since frame changes cancel along a route.
The cost is measured by [nested subspace labels](subspace-labels.md) on the edges.
